answer: Agents can earn voting weight only through a scarce, time-locked stake that is slashed when independent audits show their attestations are fabricated or coordinated. Each identity must also gain trust through repeated, costly interactions with distinct counterparties, so cloning accounts does not clone reputation. A mirror check can reveal copied behavior, but the decisive barrier is economic: a sybil operator must lock capital across accounts and risk losing it, while waiting for trust to accrue. Even a gale of ferrous-looking fake profiles cannot cheaply buy durable influence.
